name: design-to-components
description: Turn a design or screenshot into a React component kit: keep design tokens (colours, fonts, font sizes, radii, spacing, shadows) and a component checklist in the panel, the agent writes TSX components with one example per state, and the plugin type-checks them with TypeScript (strict), renders every example next to the design, bundles them with esbuild-wasm into an interactive catalog page, and outputs tokens.css and tokens.ts. Flags hard-coded colours and missing states. Local only.

description_i18n.en: Turn a design or screenshot into a React component kit: keep design tokens (colours, fonts, font sizes, radii, spacing, shadows) and a component checklist in the panel, the agent writes TSX components with one example per state, and the plugin type-checks them with TypeScript (strict), renders every example next to the design, bundles them with esbuild-wasm into an interactive catalog page, and outputs tokens.css and tokens.ts. Flags hard-coded colours and missing states. Local only.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把设计稿或截图做成 React 组件库：在面板里维护设计变量（颜色、字体、字号、圆角、间距、阴影）和组件清单，Agent 为每个组件写 TSX，每种状态一个示例；插件用 TypeScript（strict）做类型检查，把每个示例渲染出来与设计稿并排对照，用 esbuild-wasm 打包成可交互的组件目录页，并输出 tokens.css 和 tokens.ts。会提示写死的颜色和缺少的状态示例。全部在本地完成。
